label: Unit clauses
subgoals: Mark a clause satisfied as soon as one literal is true
Count the unassigned literals of each unsatisfied clause
Call the clause unit when exactly one literal is unassigned

label: Propagating to a fixpoint
subgoals: Set the literal forced by each unit clause
Rescan for clauses that have just become unit
Stop at the fixpoint and count the assigned variables

label: Propagation after a decision
subgoals: Follow each clause that the decision makes unit, then the clauses those implications make unit
Count the implied variables, excluding the decision
